maria: Design review — rollout audit breadcrumbs + traffic 'rate' pill. Figma frames here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rollout-audit?node-id=42. Need a11y + copy check before shipping next minor. ashok: Quick pass — main worry is VO readout order. If screen reader reads '50% Variant A' before the Release crumb people will lose context. Order should be hierarchical: Release > Variant > allocation. kai: Also the small pill contrast is weak at 12px. Need to hit at least 3:1 for UI components, ideally 4.5:1 for any text. Current color fails for colorblind combos. jess: From PM POV we also need consistent microcopy: '50% traffic' vs '50% allocation' vs just '50%'. Which phrasing maps best to telemetry? tim: Implementation notes: pill should be accessible via keyboard, but not a separate action unless it opens a panel. Also avoid nested interactive elements inside a breadcrumb link. Suggest aria-labels + role adjustments. maria: Suggested copy options: 1) breadcrumb item: 'Release › v12 › Variant A — 50% traffic' OR 2) keep breadcrumb short and show '50%' inside pill with aria-label '50% traffic (canary)'. Leaning to #2 to reduce visual noise. Thoughts? ashok: +1 for #2. For VO, aria-label is safer and keeps visual compactness. a11y-bot: Auto-check results: color #6B6BFF on white = 2.8:1 (fails). Recommended alternatives: #4040E0 (4.6:1) or add 1px neutral border and 4px inner padding. tim: Example implementation snippet we can use in PR: ```
  1. Release v12
  2. Variant A 50%
``` Note: pill uses role="text" not role="button" so SRs don't treat it as interactive. kai: Keyboard/focus nit: ensure focus lands on the link, not the pill. Add aria-current="page" for the current variant crumb. jess: UX question: should incremental rollout changes be announced? e.g., "Variant A increased to 50% traffic" — could be noisy but helpful in chaotic rollouts. maria: My take: use aria-live="polite" for status area, but debounce updates to avoid repeated reads when automation adjusts in quick succession. tim: Agreed on polite + debounce. Also for the rollback indicator we discussed, it reads a bit like an action. Make it presentational (role="img") plus an offscreen string for screen readers: Rollback available. Avoid clickable cursor to reduce confusion. ashok: Looks good. Will run color permutations for daltonism and make a small palette doc. maria: Next steps: I will update Figma frames (frames 42/43) with corrected pill colors and a11y notes. tim will add the aria attributes in the PR. kai will validate contrast combos. Jess, are we comfortable targeting next minor? jess: Yes target next minor. @maria please update Figma by EOD Fri; @tim please mark ETA for implementation. maria: Will update by EOD Fri — linking updated frame once done: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rollout-audit?node-id=43 tim: ETA: aiming for next Wed for initial PR, contingent on final assets + copy. ashok: Starting contrast checks now, will post swatches in this thread. :eyes: maria: Thanks everyone — I'll add the microcopy doc and final accessibility checklist to the frame comments. :thumbsup:
